sections.Profile:
The "Football" pinball machine, released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in August 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a football theme. The playfield features two flippers, two pop bumpers, twelve tower bumpers, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Football
